info.title: AgentMeter API — control plane
info.description: Accounts, stored sessions, Compare and the Leaderboard; it hands out run tokens for the GPU backend and receives the backend's signed calls. Runs as a Supabase Edge Function.

userToken.description: Access token from POST /api/auth/login on the control plane (15 minutes). Scope admin: the user's role must be admin.

runToken.description: Run token from POST /api/runs/authorize on the control plane (5 minutes; single use for actions); its scope is the token's kind. Not needed in one-user mode (no control plane).

path

controlPlaneSignature.description: The same signature with CLOUD_PREP_SECRET (control plane → preparation service).
